item.title: Refactor order status String into OrderStatus enum
item.brief:
The `orders` crate stores an order's status as a `String` and compares string literals across the code. Refactor it to a proper type. Behaviour must not change: errors, report output and ordering, and parsing must stay exactly the same, and `cargo test` must pass.

Requirements:
- Add `src/status.rs` with `pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }`, deriving at least `Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash`.
- `OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str` returns the lowercase names "pending", "paid", "shipped", "cancelled". `Display` prints the same.
- `FromStr` for `OrderStatus` with `type Err = ParseStatusError`. `ParseStatusError` is a public error type that implements `std::error::Error`, and its message names the rejected input.
- `OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool` encodes the lifecycle: pending -> paid, pending -> cancelled, paid -> shipped, paid -> cancelled. Nothing else.
- `Order::status` becomes an `OrderStatus`. Re-export `OrderStatus` and `ParseStatusError` from the crate root. Use the enum everywhere, so the status string literals appear only in `src/status.rs`.

Commit the work on the local branch. Do not push.

state.summary:
Refactored the orders crate's Order::status from String to a new OrderStatus enum, committed as c966dc7 on archon/s3cr1z7k-refactor-order-status-string-into-orders (not pushed). Added src/status.rs with OrderStatus (as_str, Display via f.pad, FromStr with ParseStatusError, can_transition_to covering exactly pending->paid, pending->cancelled, paid->shipped, paid->cancelled). Billing, shipping, cancel, is_open, outstanding_cents and ready_to_ship now use the enum; status string literals appear only in src/status.rs. Behaviour is unchanged: error messages, CSV output, the "unknown status \"lost\"" parse error, and status_counts alphabetical ordering are identical to base. Public API breaks are intentional: Order::status type and status_counts return type. Checks on head: cargo fmt --check OK, cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings OK, cargo test 7 passed (3 unit, 4 integration; baseline was 3). Review: one reviewer (agt_01M88SG79A23QEYRAXM38TRXHB) passed the head with no blocking findings. Non-blocking follow-ups: pin the alphabetical status_counts order against a future derived Ord, and add tests for the cancel error on shipped orders and successful cancel from paid. Nothing is left running; no servers were started.

pr.body: Approach: add src/status.rs (OrderStatus, ParseStatusError, transition table). Order::status is OrderStatus. billing::pay, shipping::ship and Order::cancel check can_transition_to and keep their existing error text. report::from_line parses via FromStr and keeps the old 'unknown status' message. report::status_counts returns Vec<(OrderStatus, usize)>, sorted by as_str so the output order matches the old String ordering. Key files: src/status.rs, src/order.rs, src/billing.rs, src/shipping.rs, src/report.rs, src/lib.rs, tests/orders.rs. Checks: fmt, clippy -D warnings, and cargo test (7 passed; 3 unit in status.rs, 4 integration; baseline 3). Assumptions: the public API break in Order::status and status_counts is intended. Follow-ups (non-blocking): guard the alphabetical sort against a future derived Ord; add cancel tests for shipped and paid orders.
pr.summary: Order status is now a typed enum with checked lifecycle transitions. Before: status was a String compared against literals in every module. Now: OrderStatus with as_str, Display, FromStr and can_transition_to; behaviour unchanged.
pr.title: Replace order status String with OrderStatus enum

risk.why: Intentional public API break: Order::status changes type and status_counts changes return type, so downstream callers must change. Touches src/status.rs, order, billing, shipping, report, lib and tests. Behaviour is otherwise identical to base and covered by tests. Reviewer (agt_01M88SG79A23QEYRAXM38TRXHB) rated high and passed the head with no blocking findings.
